question: What all-encompassing range must be contemplated in each place during this meditation?
premises: Meditation is to be done in each place.
The object of meditation is specified as that.
Its range extends from Śiva down to Avīci.
inference: One should meditate in every place on that reality extending from Śiva to Avīci.
plain_english: Having meditated in each and every place on that which extends from Śiva down to Avīci...
